items.title: An Agenda for Population Health-From Trust to Trustworthiness
Workplace Artificial Intelligence Use in Health Care and Non-Health Care Occupations
Perceived Financial Distress Among US Primary Care Practices
Social Trust, US Life Expectancy, and the Causes of US Working-Age Mortality
items.summary: IMPORTANCE: The US has experienced a reduction in social trust and a stagnation in its average life expectancy, associated, in part, with rising working-age mortality in those aged 25 to 64 years. While researchers have long theorized a link between better health and various types of trust, including social trust, the empirical evidence of that association with individual causes of US mortality and morbidity is sparse. The specific pathways and mechanisms by which trust influences health outcomes are similarly unclear. OBJECTIVE: To examine the role of social trust in the recent decline of US longevity and to assess the association between levels of trust and state-level differences in the causes of working-age mortality. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This cross-sectional study used survey data from the General Social Survey from years 1972 to 2024 to estimate the fraction of the US population who reported that they "trust most people." Social trust estimates for each US state in 2024 were also estimated from the Pew Research Center's Americans' Trust in One Another essay, and life expectancy at birth and 15 years, cause-specific mortality and morbidity, and lag-distributed income for adults measured at the state level were extracted from the 2023 Global Burden of Disease study for all years with General Social Survey data between 1990 and 2023. Data were analyzed from October 2024 to August 2026. MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: Adult mortality, life expectancy, and disability-adjusted life-years. Panel regression methods were used to estimate the association between the fraction of the US population with social trust and key health outcomes. RESULTS: Regression analysis showed that social trust was associated with higher life expectancy at 15 years and birth, as well as lower adult mortality rates. A 10% increase in social trust was associated with a 1.0% (95% uncertainty interval, 0.5%-1.5%) increase in life expectancy at age 15 years. If these results are causal and the US had the social trust levels observed in 2002 in 2024, then 37.1% of the gap between life expectancy at birth in the US and the mean high-income country would be closed. Greater trust was also associated with fewer disability-adjusted life-years per 10 000 population for 18 of the 25 tested health conditions explored, including many cardiometabolic diseases and opioid use disorder. However, there was no statistically significant association between the causes of US working-age mortality and trust in the press, science, the executive branch, or medicine. Social trust was associated with healthy behaviors, including physical activity and lower prevalence of smoking and obesity, and the proportion of people with health insurance. CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: This cross-sectional study suggests that social trust may improve US health outcomes primarily by encouraging healthier lifestyles. Understanding the mechanisms connecting social trust, life expectancy, and the causes of US working-age mortality is crucial for developing targeted interventions to address the recent lag in US longevity. Restoring social trust is a long-term effort, but investing in community-based health promotion targeting these mechanisms may succeed even with individuals with low trust.

items.title: THC Beverage Social Media Advertisements-When Wellness Sells Intoxication
Strengthening public health research on urban green and blue space interventions: the GIFT framework for theory development
items.summary: Urban green and blue space (UGBS) interventions are increasingly promoted as strategies to improve population health and reduce health inequities. Yet the evidence needed to guide policy and practice remains difficult to interpret because evaluations often report mixed findings, with limited understanding of how and why health effects vary. This partly reflects a lack of explicit programme theory specifying how interventions are expected to generate health outcomes, and why effects might differ across population groups and contexts. Without a robust, evidence-informed understanding of how interventions produce effects, policy and practice might rely on insufficiently tested assumptions about expected health benefits from UGBS interventions. In this Viewpoint, we introduce the green and blue space intervention framework for theory development (GIFT), which supports the development of programme theory for UGBS intervention studies. GIFT was developed through a survey, workshop, and iterative feedback involving 25 international researchers. It provides guiding questions covering intervention components, pathways and mechanisms, population variation, contextual conditions, outcomes, and timescales. By providing a shared approach to articulating how UGBS interventions are expected to work, GIFT can support more theory-informed evaluations, improve interpretation of findings, strengthen judgements about transferability, and generate more actionable evidence for effective and equitable urban green and blue space interventions.

items.title: Reply to 'Credible findings, misplaced attribution? Declining out-of-pocket health expenditure in Kerala from 2017 to 2020'
Does High-Speed Internet Access Affect the Mental Health of Older Adults?
items.summary: Recent evidence finds a negative effect of the internet on younger people's mental health, but less is known about older adults, who are more vulnerable to both mental health issues and online deception. This study estimates the effect of broadband expansion on the mental health of older adults in the United States. Using individual panel data, a staggered broadband rollout, and the latest difference-in-differences methods, I find broadband significantly improves older adults' mental health, reducing depression symptoms by 5.7% and clinical symptoms of depression by 10%. Potential mechanisms include an increase in the self-use of the internet, declines in feelings of social isolation and loneliness and suggestive evidence of improvements in the quality of virtual social connections. I find no evidence of other potential mechanisms, such as medication use for anxiety or depression and labor force outcomes, providing further support for the social mechanisms. Heterogeneity analyses provide evidence of larger improvements among rural residents, women, White respondents, and married respondents, with the clearest difference between rural and urban respondents. This work highlights broadband's additional unmeasured benefits to public investments, given the allocation of over $  65 billion to broadband expansion in recent years.

items.title: Investor logic in the United States healthcare system: how to go from here? An expert panel discussion with David Blumenthal, Erin Fuse Brown and Rob Coppedge
items.summary: Financial investors and for-profit healthcare providers play a growing role in healthcare systems. Internationally, their influence is expanding rapidly, for instance, through the development of artificial intelligence (AI) and other (smart) technologies that are highly valued by national policymakers seeking to promote disruptive innovations, which are seen as crucial to modernising contemporary health systems in the face of demographic change, constrained public resources, and a declining workforce. During the European Health Policy Group meeting in New York City that laid the basis for this special issue of Health Economics, Policy and Law, expert panels were organised to discuss these topics from different perspectives, including health policy, industry and capital, and health law. For the purposes of this special issue, we again brought together a panel of experts to discuss the contemporary financialisation of healthcare in the United States, its consequences for practitioners and policymakers, and possible courses of action to safeguard the public good. This interview paper reflects those discussions.

items.title: Politics and vaccine hesitancy: evidence from the Canadian vaccine behaviours, attitudes and perspectives (VBAP) survey
items.summary: Vaccine hesitancy is increasing worldwide when immune-based technologies are poised to advance remarkable scientific breakthroughs with potential to transform healthcare and public health. While many factors have contributed to vaccine hesitancy over time, strained social and political tensions stemming from the COVID-19 pandemic have resulted in decreased vaccine uptake and the resurgence of vaccine-preventable diseases worldwide. There has thus been substantial research on the dynamic between political identity and vaccine hesitancy. However, limited relevant research has been conducted on this dynamic in Canada, where pandemic vaccine requirements triggered political protests. Since the pandemic emergency's end, online vaccine misinformation has remained a major challenge while unprecedented political tensions with the United States have emerged. Using four waves of the Canadian Vaccine Behaviours, Attitudes and Perspectives (VBAP) Survey (December 2024 to March 2026), this paper analyses the complex associations between political alignment, trust in media, and vaccine hesitancy. This paper demonstrates associations between political alignment, vaccine perspectives and uptake, and influential media ecosystems. We conclude that addressing vaccine hesitancy for future pandemic preparedness must critically assess the implementation and communication of pandemic policies, and increase not only surveillance but engagement with online media ecosystems.

items.title: Antenatal care in West Africa: a multi-country analysis of trends and wealth-related inequality in content delivered assessed using Demographic and Health Surveys, 2003-2024
items.summary: Despite progress in expanding antenatal care (ANC) coverage across West Africa, the content of care received and its distribution across wealth groups remain incompletely characterised. Using 42 Demographic and Health Survey (DHS) rounds from 13 West African countries (2003-2024), covering 305,739 women with a live birth, we analysed trends in ANC content, wealth-related inequality, and the association between content and facility delivery. Content was measured with a four-item index of blood pressure measurement, urine test, blood sample and tetanus toxoid, with adequate content defined as at least three of the four. Inequality was quantified using Wagstaff normalised concentration indices, and predictors of facility delivery were examined using multilevel logistic regression among women who attended ANC. Counting non-attenders as not adequate, adequate content in the most recent rounds ranged from 64.9% in Nigeria to 97.2% in Gambia. Gains were largest in Sierra Leone (+48.1 percentage points, 2008-2019), Mali (+44.3, 2006-2024) and Burkina Faso (+41.9, 2003-2021). Among women who attended, blood pressure was measured for 94.9%, but a blood sample was taken for only 78.6%. Wealth-related inequality in content was substantial (concentration index 0.09 to 0.53) and, at the main threshold, exceeded inequality in the number of visits in 10 of 13 countries. Across its full range, content was more strongly associated with facility delivery (adjusted OR 3.37, 95% CI 3.18-3.57) than four or more visits (aOR 1.77, 1.72-1.83) or early initiation (aOR 1.12, 1.09-1.15). On the odds scale the association was stronger among wealthier women (content × wealth aOR 1.15, 1.11-1.21) but the absolute effect did not differ clearly by wealth, and ranged from 2.47 to 6.03 across countries. Inequality in West African antenatal care has shifted from contact to content: poorer women now reach antenatal care at rates close to those of wealthier women, but receive less once there.

items.title: Urban Primary Healthcare Purchasing in Bangladesh: Analysis of Current Arrangements, Governance Structures and Policy Landscape
items.summary: Bangladesh's urban primary healthcare (PHC) system faces governance fragmentation between Ministry of Health and Ministry of Local Government, with limited public provision and heavy reliance on donor-funded programmes delivered through private and NGO providers. Strategic purchasing is considered for potentially improving efficiency and quality, yet transitioning to this approach requires baseline understanding of current operational arrangements and mechanisms. This study examines purchasing arrangements in Bangladesh's urban PHC system, including contracting and funding modalities, and identifies their strengths and challenges. This qualitative study employed desk-based document review, 32 key informant interviews with national and city-level stakeholders, and two stakeholder validation workshops. Purposive sampling included policymakers from government ministries, local government officials, development partners, NGO project managers, and academics. Thematic analysis followed a hybrid approach combining deductive coding against WHO health system building blocks and inductive coding for emergent themes. The analysis identified four major urban PHC models predominantly delivered through public-private partnerships. Key challenges include procurement regulations that lacked provisions for healthcare services until Public Procurement Ordinance 2025 reforms, input-oriented rather than outcome-based contracting, emphasizing cost-saving over quality, governance disconnect where local government institutions hold responsibility but lack technical expertise and financial authority, chronic human resource and capacity constraints, and donor-dependency undermining sustainability. Population health needs assessment was notably absent from purchasing decisions. Recent regulatory reforms provide a legal foundation for strategic purchasing, but our findings indicate it cannot be introduced as a single reform. Successful transition requires institutional resolution of governance fragmentation, sustainable domestic financing mechanisms replacing project-based approaches, and systematic institutional capacity building in contract management and stewardship.

items.title: From centralised policy development to uneven implementation: a qualitative study of adolescent reproductive health policy processes at the national level and in Southwestern Uganda
items.summary: BACKGROUND: Adolescent pregnancy remains a significant public health and health systems concern in Uganda and across sub-Saharan Africa. Although Uganda has developed several adolescent reproductive health policies and strategies, implementation remains uneven. Less is known about how policy development and implementation processes, financing arrangements, institutional structures, and frontline discretion shape translation of adolescent reproductive health policy into practice. This study examined how adolescent reproductive health policies in Uganda are developed and implemented, and how policy actors and frontline implementers cope with related constraints. METHODS: A qualitative study was conducted between 14th July and 30th October 2025 at the national level and in Kabale and Mbarara study areas in southwestern Uganda. Twenty-eight key informants were purposively selected, including eight policymakers at national and subnational levels and twenty frontline implementers involved in adolescent reproductive health service delivery. Semi-structured interviews were recorded, transcribed, and analysed using thematic analysis combining inductive and deductive approaches, guided by Braun and Clarke's six-phase process. Themes were developed inductively and subsequently mapped onto Walt and Gilson's Health Policy Triangle domains, while Street-Level Bureaucracy theory informed interpretation of frontline discretion and coping practices. RESULTS: ARH policy development followed a structured, ministry-led process shaped by centralised decision-making and donor-dependent financing. Although institutional frameworks and development partner support facilitated policy formulation, limited subnational influence, delayed policy revision, and dependence on external funding constrained responsiveness and sustainability. At the implementation level, weak dissemination, resource shortages, limited supervision, and ambiguity around adolescents' consent expanded frontline discretion, contributing to variable service delivery. Policymakers and implementers adopted coping strategies, including service integration and resource improvisation, phased implementation, and community engagement, which sustained services but also risked normalising systemic gaps. CONCLUSIONS: Uneven implementation of adolescent reproductive health policy in Uganda does not simply reflect operational failure at the facility level. It is shaped by the interaction of financing arrangements, centralised governance, policy ambiguity and frontline discretion within a resource-constrained health system. Strengthening implementation requires stable domestic financing, clearer operational guidance, stronger subnational engagement, and institutional mechanisms that connect policy development with frontline realities.

items.title: Preliminary analysis of perioperative peripheral intravenous catheters preference and willingness to pay in patients with obesity
items.summary: BACKGROUND: Patients with obesity frequently encounter difficult intravenous access during the perioperative period. Traditional short peripheral intravenous catheters are commonly linked to an increased risk of repeated punctures and associated complications. Although novel longer peripheral intravenous catheters, including mini-midline and midline catheters, may improve vascular access reliability, evidence remains limited on how patients with obesity value their risks, benefits, costs, and device characteristics. OBJECTIVE: To quantify preferences for peripheral intravenous catheter attributes, marginal willingness to pay for these attributes, and predicted choice probabilities for predefined catheter profiles among perioperative patients with obesity. DESIGN: A cross-sectional stated-preference study using a face-to-face discrete choice experiment. SETTING: The metabolic and bariatric surgery department of a tertiary public hospital in eastern China. PARTICIPANTS: A total of 215 perioperative patients with obesity completed the survey, yielding 1,290 choice observations. METHODS: Seven catheter attributes were examined in the discrete choice experiment: maximum dwell time, insertion site, total cost, blood sampling, complication risk, catheter length, and insertion time. The choice data were analysed using a mixed logit model. The primary patient preference parameters of interest were marginal willingness-to-pay estimates for changes in catheter attributes and predicted choice probabilities for short peripheral intravenous, mini-midline, and midline catheter profiles. RESULTS: Complication risk was the most important attribute, followed by blood sampling, total cost, and catheter length, with relative importance scores of 31.85%, 25.93%, 20.98%, and 11.13%, respectively. Patients were willing to pay ¥1,366.18 CNY ($198.0 USD) to reduce complication risk from 50% to 10%, ¥659.35 CNY ($95.6 USD) to reduce it from 50% to 30%, and ¥1,112.27 CNY ($161.2 USD) for blood sampling. They required ¥477.64 CNY ($69.2 USD) in compensation to accept a 25 cm rather than a 3 cm catheter. The mini-midline catheter profile had the highest predicted choice probability (50.3%), followed by the midline catheter profile (42.3%) and the short peripheral intravenous catheter profile (7.4%). Changes in cost primarily shifted predicted choice probabilities between the mini-midline and midline catheter profiles. CONCLUSIONS: Perioperative patients with obesity placed greater importance on a lower complication risk, blood sampling, lower cost, and shorter catheter length. The mini-midline and midline catheter profiles had higher predicted choice probabilities than the short peripheral intravenous catheter profile. These findings provide an essential patient-preference evidence base for vascular access decisions, nursing practice, institutional procurement planning, and future reimbursement assessments. CLINICAL TRIAL NUMBER: Not applicable.

items.title: Facilitators and barriers influencing healthcare professionals' productivity in Ethiopia: a phenomenological study
items.summary: BACKGROUND: Understanding the lived experiences of healthcare professionals is crucial for identifying the factors that impact their productivity. In most countries in sub-Saharan Africa, particularly in Ethiopia, despite efforts to improve the performance of the health workforce, there is a lack of qualitative insights into the specific deterrents and facilitators they encounter. OBJECTIVES: This study explores the experiences of healthcare professionals in Ethiopia, focusing on the key factors that facilitate or hinder their productivity. It aims to provide insights into how healthcare professionals perceive influences on their work efficiency. METHODS: Using a phenomenological research design, we conducted in-depth and key informant interviews from July 1 to July 23, 2023, with purposively sampled healthcare providers and health leaders from hospitals across Ethiopia. Each hospital contributed one manager and two clinical staff members for the interviews. The data were analyzed using thematic analysis to uncover participants' experiences related to productivity in healthcare facilities. RESULTS: A total of 30 healthcare providers and managers working in ten hospitals from eight regions and city administrations were interviewed. The study identified five key themes related to factors that facilitate or hinder productivity: capacity building, motivation and satisfaction, performance management, work climate, and absenteeism. The main facilitators of productivity included continuous professional development opportunities, access to mentoring and coaching support, non-financial incentives, efforts to enhance work environments, and communication. On the other hand, barriers primarily consisted of resource constraints, inadequate infrastructure, a lack of transparent decision-making related to promotion and recognition, a shortage of health professionals, and the absence of a standardized performance appraisal system. Employing a phenomenological approach allowed for a deeper understanding of how healthcare professionals experience and interpret these factors in their daily work. CONCLUSION: Healthcare professionals in Ethiopia perceived productivity as closely linked to quality of care, patient outcomes, and efficient service delivery rather than quantitative measures alone. Productivity was facilitated by training, supportive supervision, mentorship, fair incentives, teamwork, and adequate resources. However, shortages of supplies and equipment, inadequate infrastructure, weak performance management systems, poor working conditions, absenteeism, and staff turnover negatively affected productivity. Addressing these organizational and system-level challenges through improved workforce support, motivation, infrastructure, and professional development may strengthen healthcare workforce productivity and retention in Ethiopia.

items.title: Systems engineering interventions in healthcare services and systems - a systematic review and framework development
items.summary: BACKGROUND: Systems design approaches show promise towards increasing efficiency and reducing costs for health systems and services, while preserving patient experience and health outcomes. However, their application has so far been limited. OBJECTIVES: This review aims to: (1) identify the state of the art systems engineering and design approaches applied to healthcare services and system, (2) develop a conceptual framework that explains how these approaches relate to each other across micro (patient), meso (service), and macro (system) levels, and (3) provide practical guidance on selecting and combining approaches for different healthcare scenarios. METHODS: The inclusion criteria were reviews of systems engineering methodologies that have been applied at a systems-level in a healthcare context, including quantitative or qualitative secondary studies such as reviews, systematic reviews, overviews, meta-analyses, and meta-syntheses. Primary studies, or studies using systems engineering methodology towards specific interventions (such as healthcare apps) rather than health services/systems, were excluded. Eleven databases were searched (Embase, HMIC, Medline, PsycInfo, SPP, AgeLine, AMED, CDAS, CINAHL, SCOPUS, WoS) on 04/11/2024 for reviews published within the previous five years. The risk of bias/quality assessment tools used applied in the included reviews was listed. A framework synthesis methodology was applied to extract data according to a framework developed a priori. RESULTS: After removing duplicates, we screened 1752 papers. 62 were sought for full text retrieval, while 57 were available. Finally, after screening for eligibility, we included 32 reviews that involve a total of 1127 studies. Our synthesis reveals that systems engineering and design methodologies have been increasingly applied in healthcare service contexts, with service design, service improvement, and service development as the most common areas of focus. User-centred design and co-design approaches have enabled more inclusive and patient-responsive service frameworks, while systems approaches have provided tools for managing complexity at policy and organisational levels. Distinctions among sub-methodologies (such as the degree of structure, depth of user engagement, and level of system intervention) highlight the importance of aligning methodological choice with healthcare context and stakeholder needs. Despite growing adoption, significant gaps remain in outcome standardization, implementation evaluation, and adaptation for low-resource or culturally diverse settings. Based on these findings, a conceptual framework was developed to map how systems engineering and design methodologies operate across micro (individual), meso (service), and macro (system) levels of healthcare. The framework highlights that system-level change requires systems thinking combined with stakeholder engagement, whereas patient-level improvement is supported by design thinking as well as patient-engaged co-design approaches that do not necessarily follow a formal design thinking process. CONCLUSIONS: This review shows that different methodologies offer distinct strengths across different levels of healthcare. User-centred design and co-design approaches are most effective for addressing patient-level challenges, enhancing usability, engagement, and experiential outcomes. In contrast, system-level transformation requires systems thinking and structured stakeholder engagement to manage complexity and support sustainable organisational and policy change. The promoted conceptual framework advances understanding of how to match methodological choice to context and contributes a foundation for more integrated, patient-centred, and system-responsive healthcare improvement.

items.title: Healthcare workforce resilience amidst civil unrest: a cross-sectional study on personal coping and health system resilience knowledge in a low-and-middle-income-country setting
items.summary: BACKGROUND: In healthcare, resilience is a necessity, and the perceived health system resilience among healthcare providers is critical in their ability to cope with challenges. OBJECTIVE: Assess the healthcare workforce resilience status against their perception of the health system's resilience in Tibebe-Ghion Teaching Referral Hospital, Northwest Ethiopia. METHODS: A hospital-based cross-sectional study was conducted between September 1 and December 15, 2025, including 501 participants selected via simple random sampling technique. We analyzed our data-covering demographics, the 25-item Connor-Davidson Resilience Scale, and Kruk's health system resilience index-using SPSS version 27. Categorical data were summarized as frequencies and percentages, and discrete data as means. Binary logistic regression was performed with 95% confidence intervals, and significance was set at P < 0.05. RESULTS: Compared to the reference short-cycle tertiary education (ISCED level 5), healthcare providers with a second and third-degree education were more likely to perceive the health system as resilient (adjusted odds ratio of 4.753 (1.237, 18.263) and 8.968 (1.990, 40.418), respectively). Healthcare providers with higher perceived health system resilience reported higher personal resilience (adjusted odds ratio of 2.165 (1.506, 3.113)). CONCLUSION: Better-educated healthcare providers tend to view the health system as supportive. Recovery from adversity is related to how robust a provider perceives the health system to be, highlighting that adaptive coping is deeply tied to workplace trust than expecting individual employees to single-handedly "bounce back" from stress.

items.title: Supervision best practices to train and retain the early career behavioral health workforce: a scoping review and expert interviews
items.summary: BACKGROUND: The U.S. behavioral health system is experiencing critical workforce shortages. Early career behavioral health clinicians (ECBHCs)-professionals with master's or doctoral degrees and one to three years post-graduate experience-face unique challenges in obtaining required supervision for independent licensure. While supervision is mandated for professional development, empirical consensus is limited on what constitutes high-quality supervision and its role as a workforce retention mechanism. This study aimed to address this gap by examining models, practices, and systemic factors that influence the quality and function of supervision for ECBHCs. METHODS: This study employed a two-phase design. Phase one was a PRISMA-ScR-guided scoping review (protocol registered on Open Science Foundation) of peer-reviewed, U.S.-based studies (2014-2024) on supervision practices or outcomes for ECBHCs - master's- or doctoral-level clinicians in social work, counseling, marriage and family therapy, or psychology with ≤ 5 years of postgraduate experience. Four databases were searched; two reviewers screened records and charted data using a standardized extraction guide. Phase two comprised 12 expert interviews analyzed using reflexive thematic analysis. Findings from both phases were integrated to recommend future workforce practice and policy. RESULTS: Seven studies met inclusion criteria; none evaluated supervision as a workforce intervention. Supervision outcomes were reported at the individual level and barriers included inconsistent requirements, poor supervisory fit, harmful or inadequate practices, and financial burden. Expert interviews reinforced findings and identified four themes: (1) benefits of supervision for skill development and burnout mitigation, (2) challenges (i.e., administrative complexity, training gaps), (3) adaptive strategies (i.e., telesupervision, contracts) and (4) policy priorities, including licensure standardization and financial support for supervision access. CONCLUSIONS: Supervision is a requisite for ECBHCs' independent licensure and clinical training. Despite its importance, findings underscored that its quality and potential function as a strategic workforce intervention remain nascent. While data suggests that high-quality supervision can improve clinician confidence and competence, systemic barriers persist that undermine supervision affordability and accessibility. Coordinated efforts among policymakers, professional associations, and organizations are needed to standardize requirements, fund training and access, and integrate evaluation tools. Without such action, supervision remains underutilized in addressing the broader behavioral health workforce crisis.

items.title: Health workforce capacity shocks reduce surveillance visibility: natural experiment evidence from a secondary hospital in Nigeria
items.summary: BACKGROUND: Health workforce shortages weaken health systems in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), but the causal effect of specific workforce loss on surveillance of surgically managed diseases is unquantified. This study tested whether loss of a resident surgeon would be associated with cessation of documented surgically confirmed typhoid intestinal perforation (TIP). METHODS: We conducted a natural experiment study utilizing multi-method from January 2023 to December 2024 in Nasarawa State, Nigeria. We included 7 of the 23 hospitals in the state as follows: 1 secondary hospital with a resident surgeon, 5 secondary hospitals with visiting surgeons only, and 1 tertiary (as control) with full-time employed surgeons. The shock incident occurred in July 2024 when the sole resident surgeon departed from one secondary hospital. Primary outcome was monthly documentation rate of surgically confirmed TIP. Data were extracted from theatre registers and compared for pre-departure vs. post-departure TIP rates using Fisher's exact test and exact Poisson tests. A cross-sectional survey of 440 healthcare providers to assess documentation perceptions was also conducted with a 98.4% response rate. RESULTS: The affected hospital documented 13 TIP cases over 18 months pre-departure, rate 0.72 cases per month, compared to 0 cases over 6 months post-departure, rate 0.00 cases per month (IRR 0.00, 95% CI 0.00-0.98, p = 0.048). The 5 secondary hospitals with visiting surgeons documented 16 TIP cases total with stable rates: 0.61/month pre (11/18 months) and 0.83/month post (5/6 months), IRR 1.36, 95% CI 0.37-4.26, p = 0.567. The tertiary hospital recorded 148 TIP cases over 24 months, overall rate 6.17/month: 6.11/month pre (110/18 months) and 6.33/month post (38/6 months), IRR 1.04, 95% CI 0.70-1.51, p = 0.850. Survey data from 433 respondents showed 78.5% agreed that workforce shortages reduce documentation of surgical cases. CONCLUSIONS: Loss of a resident surgeon was associated with cessation of documented surgically confirmed TIP at the affected facility, while documentation continued at concurrent controls. We proposed the "GH Doma Principle": health information systems should include workforce capacity as a surveillance denominator. Zero facility cases should not automatically be interpreted as absence of disease burden without consideration of organizational capacity. CLINICAL TRIAL NUMBER: Not applicable.

items.title: Towards an explicit national health benefit package for Malaysia: a participatory multi-method study into stakeholder perspectives and evidence-informed policy design
items.summary: BACKGROUND: Universal Health Coverage (UHC) is a global imperative to ensure equitable access and financial protection. While many nations utilize health benefit packages (HBPs) to define these entitlements, the transition from implicit to explicit prioritization remains a significant policy challenge. This study explored the perspectives of Malaysian healthcare stakeholders regarding the potential architecture, guiding principles, and operational modalities of an explicit National HBP (NHBP) within the context of national health reform. METHODS: We employed a participatory, multi-method qualitative design utilizing a modified Policy Delphi framework inspired by Evidence-Informed Deliberative Processes (EDPs). The study was executed in two phases: (1) semi-structured key informant interviews (n = 7) to identify core system bottlenecks, followed by (2) a dual-arm Policy Delphi workshop (n = 84) integrating baseline evidence briefs with deliberative foresight tools. To enhance deliberative rigour, specialized techniques including Problem Mapping, Futures Wheel, and Fishbowl discussions were utilized. Data were analysed using a thematic triangulation approach to ensure the inclusivity and robustness of the resulting framework. RESULTS: Triangulation revealed seven interdependent system domains essential for NHBP implementation: a robust governance model, a sustainable financing architecture, the central role of health technology assessment (HTA), a phased implementation pace, an equity-centred approach, a defined system scope and a transparent framework with legal anchoring. Furthermore, nine priority-setting criteria were identified: clinical effectiveness, cost-effectiveness, safety, budget impact, feasibility, strategic alignment, equity, burden of disease, and social acceptability. Stakeholders emphasized that an explicit NHBP must transcend technocratic design, requiring social legitimacy and statutory protection to be sustainable. CONCLUSIONS: This study presents a stakeholder-driven, evidence-informed framework and implementation roadmap for an explicit NHBP in Malaysia, moving beyond traditional top-down policy design. By utilizing deliberative foresight techniques, the research offers an actionable roadmap that aligns Malaysia's UHC journey with systemic reform priorities.

items.title: An input-process-output operational performance model for a long-term care day care center using routinely collected administrative data
items.summary: BACKGROUND: Day care centers for long-term care manage staffing, attendance, service use, and costs under reimbursement constraints. Routine administrative records can support monitoring but do not fully capture Balanced Scorecard (BSC) constructs such as staff development, service quality, user experience, or organizational learning. This study examined how these records could be organized and interpreted within a BSC-informed input-process-output operational performance model. METHODS: This retrospective secondary analysis used 226 operating-day observations from one day care center in Seoul, South Korea, nested within 11 months. Indicators were organized as input indicators, process indicators, utilization output, and financial/accounting outputs. Total pay and Total operating expenses were log-transformed, and model variables were standardized. Direct paths used finite-sample-corrected month-clustered inference and 5,000 month-block bootstrap draws; indirect and total associations used the same bootstrap procedure. RESULTS: The retained model yielded the following conventional in-sample fit indices: chi-square = 7.370, df = 6, p =.288, GFI = 0.998, TLI = 0.988, CFI = 0.997, and RMSEA = 0.032. It accounted for 39.3% of the variance in beneficiary status, 39.3% of the variance in Total pay, and 49.1% of the variance in the allocated daily operating expense proxy. Non-use count was negatively associated with beneficiary status. Service count was positively associated with Total pay, an expected linkage because both measures originated from the claim-record process. Cost-related inference was method-sensitive: the month-block 95% confidence interval for the path from Service count to Total operating expenses included zero despite a statistically significant CR1 cluster-robust test. CONCLUSIONS: Routinely collected administrative records can be organized into an input-process-output operational performance framework using the BSC as a broad organizing lens. Because the indicators were administrative proxies rather than full measures of BSC constructs and the data were obtained from a single facility, the findings should be interpreted as exploratory associations rather than evidence of causal effects or cost-efficiency gains.

items.title: Structural factors influencing the adoption and adaption of foreign innovations in health service delivery in the Chinese context: a qualitative study
items.summary: INTRODUCTION: Many Global Health initiatives aim to disseminate best practices to developing countries to improve access and quality of care. However, current concepts of successful innovation are primarily based on studies conducted in developed, Western countries. Little is known about the structural factors influencing the uptake of these innovations in non-Western developing countries. This gap motivated our study on the introduction of 'best international practices in health service delivery' in China. METHODS: We conducted semi-structured online interviews with 20 participants, consisting of 10 Chinese, 9 Dutch, and 1 German, to advance scientific understanding of this topic. RESULTS: Four themes of structural factors that influence the adoption and adaption of health service delivery innovations originating from abroad in China emerged. These four themes include: Alignment with governmental policies and regulations, Leadership engagement on multiple levels, Alignment between internal stakeholders, and Matching incentives with both organizational and personal interests. While adoption is always top-down, adaption often follows a bottom-up approach in the Chinese context. Resource scarcity in primary care institutions adds extra difficulties to bottom-up innovations. Health professionals' motivations to adopt and adapt foreign innovations are primarily controlled (externally) instead of autonomous (internally), which can diminish sustainability. Reducing workload and increasing salaries can facilitate resolving motivation challenges. CONCLUSION: Our findings indicate that differences exist in the adoption and adaptation of foreign innovations in developing countries with tight government control and a centralized health system such as China, compared to developed countries with decentralized health systems.

items.title: Improving the health of Australians with disability: recommendations from a federal-level policy forum
items.summary: BACKGROUND: People with disability experience poorer health outcomes than those without disability. These disparities were exacerbated by the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic, prompting the Australian government to implement significant changes to health and other essential services for people with disability. To reflect on these changes, the Centre of Research Excellence in Disability and Health (CRE-DH) - which consisted of investigators from five Australian universities - invited senior government officials and disability advocates to a federal-level policy forum. This study examines the recommendations arising from that forum and explores how they align with subsequent government reports and policies, offering a perspective for advancing health equity for people with disability. METHODS: In September 2022, 32 senior representatives from 16 organisations participated in one of two identical half-day virtual workshops. Operating under Chatham House Rule to facilitate open discussion, each workshop included two small-group working sessions facilitated by an academic from the CRE-DH and focussed on improving health outcomes for people with disability: (1) within the health system, and (2) across disability, health, and other sectors. We used a six-phase thematic analysis approach to summarize the issues and ensuing recommendations that we grouped into strategic policy focus areas. RESULTS: Twelve recommendations were made to tackle health inequities across three domains: whole-of-government, health system, and cross-sectoral disability and health system reforms. Participants emphasised the unique interplay between social welfare and health systems for people with disability and highlighted the lack of coordination and accountability across government that is needed to achieve genuinely joined‑up systems. Key recommendations included: developing a National Disability and Health Strategy; implementing Disability Impact Assessments; and addressing the absence of disability identifiers in administrative systems. DISCUSSION AND CONCLUSIONS: The researcher-led policy forum offered an opportunity to disrupt traditional government-led consultations through intersectoral and more secure open discussions. Our approach aimed to provide more equitable collaboration between different stakeholders with the policy forum resulting in actionable recommendations on persistent issues. While recent policies address some of the recommendations, others remain unfulfilled despite being echoed in two major national reports and their potential to strengthen disability-inclusive health policy and advance health equity for all people with disability.

items.title: Implementing collaborative learning platforms for healthcare quality improvement in Lao PDR: a case study of national forums
items.summary: BACKGROUND: Healthcare quality and safety initiatives in low- and middle-income countries often face fragmentation due to varying stakeholders' readiness levels. Collective learning facilitates knowledge exchange and institutional capacity building, which are crucial for overcoming organizational constraints in quality improvement (QI) implementation. However, its feasibility and effectiveness in resource-limited settings remain to be studied. This study examined the feasibility and effectiveness of collaborative learning forums for healthcare QI in Lao PDR implemented through the Japan International Cooperation Agency project. METHODS: This descriptive case study analyzed four dimensions of collaborative learning forums using existing documentation: participant engagement (overall and self-funded participation), learning environment (topic evolution, QI activity distribution, and participant feedback), QI readiness, and the role of international cooperation. Inductive qualitative analysis was conducted to extract key lessons, and deductive analysis applied a framework for knowledge transfer readiness to assess QI readiness. QI activities were classified using a Japanese QI typology: problem solving, task achievement, countermeasure implementation, and prevention. RESULTS: Over four years, participation increased from 65 to 234 attendees and from 14 to 97 institutions, with self-funded participation rising from 7.7% to 52.1%. Survey responses indicated that 89.0% were willing to recommend a forum to their colleagues. Discussion topics evolved from policy implementation and QI methods to broader issues such as hospital governance, patient safety, and crisis response. Problem solving was the dominant QI approach, followed by task achievement, countermeasure implementation, and prevention. However, 19.5% of efforts remained in the situational assessment stage, especially on patient and staff satisfaction. CONCLUSIONS: A structured collective learning platform can enhance QI readiness in low-resource settings by fostering shared understanding and promoting iterative learning. To maximize its potential, it is essential to cultivate local ownership, engage multilevel leadership, and create culturally aligned learning environments that empower local actors. Such environments should not rely on rigid tools or externally led solutions but enable teams to explore and adapt approaches to their context. International cooperation may need to initially provide support but gradually shift towards facilitation, especially in centralized governance systems, helping to sustain QI efforts through local adaptation and long-term integration into health systems.

items.title: Prevalence and economic burden of polypharmacy in a secondary healthcare facility in North-Central Nigeria: a cross-sectional study
items.summary: BACKGROUND: Polypharmacy, commonly defined as the concurrent use of five or more medications, is an increasing public health concern worldwide, particularly among patients with chronic diseases. Although the use of multiple medications may be clinically necessary, polypharmacy is associated with adverse drug reactions, poor adherence, increased healthcare utilization, and substantial financial burden. In low- and middle-income countries such as Nigeria, where healthcare financing depends largely on out-of-pocket payment, the economic impact of polypharmacy on patients can be considerable. This study assessed the prevalence and economic burden of polypharmacy among patients attending a secondary healthcare facility in North-Central Nigeria. METHODS: A cross-sectional study was conducted at Offa Specialist Hospital, Kwara State, Nigeria. The study comprised a retrospective review of 2,000 prescriptions issued between January and June 2025 to determine the prevalence of polypharmacy and a prospective questionnaire survey involving 100 patients and 50 healthcare providers conducted between July and August 2025 to assess medication-related financial burden and perceptions of polypharmacy. RESULTS: Polypharmacy was observed in 37.0% of reviewed prescriptions (740/2,000). Of the prescriptions reviewed, 25.0% contained 5-9 medications (major polypharmacy) and 12.0% contained 10 or more medications (excessive polypharmacy). Most prescriptions (63.0%) contained 2-4 medications. Among patients surveyed, 37% reported spending more than ₦20,000 monthly on medications, and 79% indicated that medication cost constituted a financial burden. 66% of patients reported skipping or reducing medications due to cost, while 78% required financial assistance to obtain prescribed drugs. Among healthcare providers, 84% frequently encountered patients taking five or more medications, and all providers agreed that polypharmacy significantly increases treatment cost. CONCLUSION: Polypharmacy is prevalent and remains a significant prescribing concern in this secondary healthcare setting and imposes a substantial economic burden on patients. Strengthening medication review practices, promoting rational prescribing, and expanding health insurance coverage may help reduce unnecessary polypharmacy and its financial consequences in resource-limited settings.

items.title: Quality of care and outcomes of transfusion-dependent thalassaemia in Sabah, Malaysia: a registry-based comparison of specialist and non-specialist hospitals
items.summary: BACKGROUND: Thalassaemia is a common inherited autosomal recessive haemoglobinopathy in Malaysia, with a high disease burden in the state of Sabah. Despite universal health coverage, geographical and health system challenges may influence quality of care and outcomes across hospital settings. This study aimed to characterise the epidemiology of transfusion-dependent thalassemia (TDT) in Sabah and compare the quality-of-care indicators and clinical outcomes between specialist and non-specialist hospitals. METHODS: This cross-sectional study using data from the Malaysian Thalassaemia Registry (MTR) in year 2023 included all TDT patients under active follow-up in 22 public hospitals in Sabah. Patients were categorised by hospital type (specialist vs. non-specialist). Key quality indicators and outcomes assessed included serum ferritin, pre-transfusion haemoglobin (Hb), chelation regimens, thalassaemia-related complications, T2*-weighted magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) monitoring for cardiac and liver iron, and mortality. Descriptive analyses were performed. RESULTS: Of 1,865 thalassaemia patients, 1,425 (76.4%) were TDT. Median age was 15 years (IQR: 9-22), most were aged < 20 years and of Kadazan-Dusun ethnicity. β-thalassemia major accounted for 89.7% of diagnoses. Overall, median serum ferritin was 3,423 µg/L (IQR: 1,929-6,242) and lower in specialist hospitals compared to non-specialist hospitals (median: 3,235 µg/L vs. 3,625 µg/L). More than one-third (35.7%) of patients achieved serum ferritin of < 2,500 µg/L with a significantly greater proportion in specialist hospitals. Pre-transfusion Hb levels were suboptimal (median: 8.1 g/dl, IQR: 7.2-8.8) with specialist hospitals achieving higher median Hb and a greater proportion of patients meeting the ≥ 9 g/dL target. Biennial T2* MRI adherence was better in specialist hospitals, although complications were more frequently reported. In 2023, 42 deaths (2.9%) occurred, predominantly among patients < 30 years. Deaths in non-specialist hospitals occurred at younger ages. Although infection remained the leading cause (61.9%), cardiac-related deaths were more frequently reported in non-specialist hospitals (31.6% vs. 8.7%). CONCLUSION: Thalassaemia care and outcomes in Sabah remained below national standards. Patients managed in specialist hospitals were achieving better ferritin control, pre-transfusion Hb, and adherence to recommended monitoring. These disparities underscore the urgent need to strengthen healthcare delivery across the state, particularly in non-specialist settings where gaps in care are most pronounced.

items.title: Sexual wellbeing in Britain: findings from the fourth National Survey of Sexual Attitudes and Lifestyles (Natsal-4)
items.summary: BACKGROUND: Sexual wellbeing is an individual state of feeling respected, safe, and comfortable with sex and sexuality, and having self-esteem, agency, and support in one's sexual life. It is related to, but distinct from, sexual function and sexual health. The epidemiology of sexual wellbeing in a general population is not well understood. We aimed to examine inequalities in low sexual wellbeing, and discover associations with sexual behaviour, sexual and reproductive health experiences, and general and mental health. We sought to understand which individual items within our validated 13-item measure of sexual wellbeing (the Natsal-SW) are most strongly associated with key sexual health behaviours and indicators. METHODS: We conducted the fourth National Survey of Sexual Attitudes and Lifestyles (Natsal-4), which is a large nationally representative cross-sectional study of people aged 16-59 years who are resident in Britain (data used here collected between Sept 20, 2022, and Dec 3, 2023). 4160 participants reporting sexual experience ever completed the Natsal-SW; standardised score range 0-52, low selected as ≤33, and high as ≥48. Focusing attention on those with most need, we used age-adjusted logistic regressions to examine associations with low sexual wellbeing. FINDINGS: The weighted prevalence of current low sexual wellbeing was similar in women (14·3% [95% CI 12·6-16·3]) and men (13·7% [11·7-15·9]), but high sexual wellbeing was slightly less prevalent in women than men (20·7% [95% CI 18·7- 22·8] vs 24·4% [21·8- 27·1]; p=0·024). Nine items on Natsal-SW differed by gender; notably women were more likely to report feeling upset with others about past sexual events, and men to report feeling ashamed about sexual thoughts. The odds of low sexual wellbeing were greater among young people (aged 16-24 years), individuals from sexual and gender minorities, individuals reporting lower income and, among women only, educational level. Low sexual wellbeing was associated with reporting first sex after age 25 years, symptoms of sexually-transmitted infections and less frequent sex in the past month, at least four partners, distressing sexual problems, and sexual violence in the past year, and at least one same-sex partner in the past 5 years. Low sexual wellbeing was associated with currently screening positive for depression (Patient Health Questionnaire-2-item) and anxiety (Generalised Anxiety Disorder-2-item) symptoms and low mental wellbeing, particularly among men. Associations between key sexual health and behaviour indicators, and low sexual wellbeing, remained after adjustment for mental health. INTERPRETATION: Low sexual wellbeing is unequally distributed, and patterns of association differ notably from sexual health. These data support future inclusion of sexual wellbeing in population health policy and intervention. FUNDING: Wellcome Trust, the UK Economic and Social Research Council, and the UK National Institute for Health and Care Research.

items.title: Sexually transmitted infections, behavioural risks, and uptake of sexual health services in Britain from 2010 to 2024: findings from the repeated cross-sectional National Surveys of Sexual Attitudes and Lifestyles (Natsal)
items.summary: BACKGROUND: Sexually transmitted infection (STI) diagnoses have increased in Britain since 2010, alongside major changes to sexual health policy, services, and disruptions owing to the COVID-19 pandemic. Meanwhile, sexual activity has decreased at population level, and more people report same-sex behaviours. To understand implications for HIV and STI control, we examined the general population prevalence of three STIs, sexual behaviours associated with STIs, and uptake of sexual health services, including HIV and chlamydia testing. METHODS: We conducted the fourth National Surveys of Sexual Attitudes and Lifestyles (Natsal-4) between Sept 20, 2022, and April 5, 2024. In this analysis, we used cross-sectional data from 5949 sexually experienced (who reported ever having sex) participants aged 16-59 years in Britain from the probability sample surveys. We estimated weighted prevalences for STIs using biosamples (vaginal swabs or urine samples; n=2721), self-reported STI-associated behaviours (including a composite of ≥4 partners, condomless sex with ≥2 partners in the past year, or overlapping partners in the past 5 years), and sexual health service uptake. Comparisons were made between groups defined by partners' sex and over time by comparing with Natsal-3 (2010-12). FINDINGS: In Natsal-4, overall prevalence of Chlamydia trachomatis, Neisseria gonorrhoeae, and Trichomonas vaginalis was less than 1·0%. C trachomatis prevalence was highest in women aged 16-24 years (4·0%, 95% CI 1·3-11·7). STI-associated behaviours (composite) were most prevalent in young people (aged 16-24 years) with only opposite-sex partners (women 26·5%, 95% CI 20·2-33·9; men 29·4%, 22·5-37·6), women reporting sex with women and men (WSWM; 60·0%, 49·0-70·1), and men reporting sex with men (MSM; 57·1%, 48·6-65·3). Among those with only opposite-sex partners, past-year uptake was higher in women than men for sexual health service use (women 8·3%, 7·2-9·6; men 3·9%, 3·0-5·1), HIV testing (women 5·8%, 4·9-7·0; men 2·8%, 2·1-3·7), and chlamydia testing (women 8·4%, 7·1-10·1; men 4·7%, 3·4-6·4). Among participants reporting STI-associated behaviours, apart from MSM (47·3%, 36·1-58·8), the majority of people who reported STI-associated behaviours had not taken up services (eg, for sexual health services in participants with opposite-sex partners: women 73·8%, 67·8-79·1; men 84·9%, 79·4-89·4; WSWM 68·6%, 54.1-80.2). Between Natsal-3 and Natsal-4, HIV testing increased in MSM, sexual health service use decreased in young men with only opposite-sex partners, and chlamydia testing markedly declined (eg, in all women aged 16-24 years: Natsal-3 54·2%, 51·4-57·0; Natsal-4 17·8%, 12·7-24·5). INTERPRETATION: Many people remain at behavioural risk for STIs, particularly young people, WSWM, and MSM. Most people with STI-associated behaviours had not used sexual health services in the past year. Declining chlamydia testing and high prevalence in young women might cause reproductive harm. Universal sexual health services remain essential. FUNDING: Wellcome Trust, Economic and Social Research Council, and the National Institute for Health and Care Research.

items.title: Socioeconomic Disparities in Heat-Related Illness in Korea: A Nationwide 10-Year Study
items.summary: BACKGROUND: Heat-related illness represents a growing public health concern, yet socioeconomic disparities in heat vulnerability remain poorly characterized in Korea. We examined trends and socioeconomic disparities in heat-related illness incidence across Korea from 2014 to 2023. METHODS: We conducted a nationwide repeated cross-sectional study using health insurance claims data for 52.6 million individuals. Heat-related illness cases were identified using International Classification of Diseases-10 codes T67.0-T67.9. We calculated annual incidence rates stratified by insurance type (National Health Insurance vs. Medical Aid), sex, age, and region. Poisson regression with a person-year offset was used to estimate incidence rate ratios (IRRs) for sociodemographic factors, and generalized estimating equations were used to quantify the association between mean maximum temperature during heatwave periods and heat-related illness incidence, with effect modification by socioeconomic status. RESULTS: Over the 10 years, we identified 181,224 heat-related illness cases. Medical Aid recipients had a 28% higher incidence of heat-related illness than National Health Insurance beneficiaries (incidence rate ratio, 1.28; 95% confidence interval, 1.25-1.31). Individuals aged ≥ 85 years showed 2.54-fold higher incidence than those aged 0-19 years (incidence rate ratio, 2.54; 95% confidence interval, 2.47-2.62). Geographic disparities were pronounced, with Jeju showing up to 4.22-fold higher incidence compared with Seoul (incidence rate ratio, 4.22; 95% confidence interval, 4.13-4.32). CONCLUSION: Socioeconomic and geographic disparities in heat-related illness persist in Korea despite universal coverage. These findings underscore the need for targeted interventions prioritizing vulnerable populations and highlight that health equity requires addressing structural determinants beyond healthcare access.

items.title: Neobladder Impact on Liver Function: A Nationwide Analysis
items.summary: BACKGROUND: Radical cystectomy (RC) with urinary diversion alters gastrointestinal and metabolic physiology. Orthotopic neobladders (NBs) have traditionally been viewed with caution in patients with hepatic concerns owing to potential reabsorption of urinary solutes. This study aimed to investigate the long-term risks of de novo liver disease, hypertension (HTN), and diabetes mellitus (DM) after RC, challenging the prevailing assumption of hepatic toxicity from NB diversion. METHODS: This retrospective nationwide cohort study used data from the Korean National Health Insurance Service database (2010-2023). Patients without preoperative liver disease, HTN, or DM were included. Primary endpoints were the incidence of liver disease, HTN, and DM. Inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW) balanced covariates in NB and ileal conduit (IC) groups. Cox proportional hazard models were used to estimate hazard ratios (HRs). RESULTS: In the IPTW-adjusted cohort (n = 22,144), NB was associated with a 29% lower risk of de novo liver disease compared with IC (HR, 0.71; 95% confidence interval, 0.59-0.84; P < 0.001). Patients with NB also demonstrated a lower incidence of liver cirrhosis (2.04% vs. 2.63%; P = 0.003). In the open-surgery subgroup, NB was associated with reduced risks of HTN (HR 0.92; P < 0.001) and DM (HR, 0.94; P = 0.028). Limitations include the retrospective design and use of administrative codes as diagnoses. CONCLUSION: Contrary to long-standing concerns regarding urea reabsorption, NB diversion was associated with a lower incidence of de novo liver disease and better metabolic preservation than IC diversion.

items.title: 의료데이터 가명처리 심의 위험도별 차등화…LLM 활용기준 마련
items.summary:
의료데이터 가명처리 심의 위험도별 차등화
안전기준 충족 땐 심의 면제·서류 간소화
LLM 서버 국내 설치·의료데이터 학습 금지
전체 내용을 이해하기 위해서는 기사 본문과 함께 읽어야 합니다.
(서울=연합뉴스) 김영신 기자 = 의료데이터 활용을 활성화하기 위해 가명정보 활용에 따른 위험도별로 심의 절차가 차등화되고 일정한 안전 기준을 충족하면 심의가 면제된다.
대규모 언어모델(LLM)을 활용할 때는 서버를 국내에 두고 입력한 의료데이터를 저장하거나 학습에 활용하지 못하도록 하는 등 안전 기준도 마련된다.
보건복지부는 인공지능(AI) 시대에 의료데이터를 더 안전하고 효율적으로 활용할 수 있도록 하기 위해 '보건의료데이터 활용 지침(가이드라인)'을 이같이 전부 개정한다고 26일 밝혔다.
AI 기술 발전으로 의료데이터 활용 수요가 빠르게 증가하는 가운데, 현장에서는 가명처리 기준이 모호하고 심의 절차와 서류가 복잡해 데이터 활용에 어려움이 있다는 지적이 제기돼 왔다.
특히 생성형 AI, 대규모 언어모델(LLM)을 진료·연구에 활용하려는 시도가 늘어나면서 환자 정보를 보호하면서 LLM을 안전하게 활용하기 위한 기준을 마련할 필요성이 커졌다.
개정 가이드라인은 우선 정형 데이터에 대해 구체적으로 삭제할 정보를 열거한 가명처리 안전 기준을 제시한다.
해당 기준을 충족하는 정보는 기관보건의료정보 심의위원회(DRB)의 심의를 면제하는 근거를 마련했다.
이를 통해 기관 간 가명처리 수준의 편차를 줄이고, 정형데이터를 활용할 때마다 반복됐던 심의 부담을 덜 수 있을 것으로 복지부는 기대했다.
가이드라인은 또한 가명정보를 외부로 반출하지 않고 통제된 환경에서 안전하게 분석할 수 있도록 '원격분석환경 운영기준'을 제시했다.
아울러 모든 가명정보 활용에 동일한 심의를 적용하던 기존 방식에서 벗어나 활용 주체(내부 활용 또는 제3자 제공)와 처리 환경을 기준으로 기본 위험도를 판단하고, 추가 요소를 고려해 위험도를 조정하도록 했다.
판단된 위험도에 따라 심의 방식을 다르게 적용한다. 저위험은 담당자가, 중위험은 담당자와 심의위원 등 2명 이상이 참여해 신속 심의를 한다. 고위험은 정규 심의를 거치도록 한다.
가이드라인은 LLM기반 의료데이터 활용 기준을 새롭게 마련했다.
LLM 서버는 국내에 물리적으로 위치하도록 하고, 입력한 의료데이터가 LLM 모델 내에 저장되거나 학습에 활용되지 않도록 하는 등의 기준을 제시했다.
이외에 의료기관의 가명처리 위탁을 허용하고, 가명처리 단계별로 작성하던 행정서류 양식을 23종에서 10종으로 간소화하는 내용 등을 담았다.
복지부는 개정 가이드라인과 관련해 의료기관, 연구자, DRB 위원 등을 대상으로 교육·설명회를 추진한다.
특히 새로 도입된 기준에 대해 사례 중심으로 안내 자료를 보완할 예정이다.
최경일 첨단의료지원단장은 "이번 개정은 데이터 보호 수준을 높이면서도 현장의 불필요한 부담은 줄여 의료데이터를 안전하게 활용할 수 있는 명확한 기준을 마련했다는 데 의미가 있다"고 말했다.

items.title: 의사 국시 일부 과목 만점자 7배로…복지부 "이상사례 없어"
items.summary:
의사 국시 보건의약법규 만점자 7배 증가
정신간호학 만점자 늘고 기본간호학은 감소
복지부 "특정 과목만으로 부정 판단 어려워"
전체 내용을 이해하기 위해서는 기사 본문과 함께 읽어야 합니다.
(서울=연합뉴스) 고유선 기자 = 최근 스마트기기와 인공지능(AI) 기술을 활용한 국가시험 부정행위 의혹이 잇따르는 가운데 의사 등 보건의료인 국가시험 일부 과목에서도 만점자가 크게 늘어난 것으로 나타났다.
정부는 다만, 매년 과목별 점수 등락이 있을 수 있는 데다 의사 국시의 경우 실기시험도 치러야 하므로 필기시험 일부 과목의 만점자가 늘었다는 것만으로 이상 사례가 있다고 볼 수는 없다고 설명했다.
26일 국회 보건복지위 이만희 위원장(국민의힘)이 한국보건의료인국가시험원에서 제출받은 자료를 보면 의사 국가시험에서 보건의약관계법규 과목 만점자가 2022년 20명에서 올해 두 차례 시험을 합쳐 137명(42명+95명)으로 늘었다.
다만, 320점 만점의 필기시험에서 배점이 가장 큰 의학각론(만점 240점)의 경우 올해 최고점(각 230점·232점)이나 평균점수(각 193.96점·196.32점)가 2023년(최고점 232점·평균 195.98점)과 크게 다르지 않았다.
의사 국가시험은 통상 연 1회 치러지지만, 의정 갈등에 따른 의대생 수업 거부 등의 여파로 올해는 두 차례 치러졌다. 2022년에는 3천312명, 올해는 두 차례 시험을 합쳐 2천624명이 응시했다.
다른 직종의 경우 간호사 국시에서 2022년 나오지 않았던 성인간호학 만점자가 올해는 25명이었고, 2022년 376명이었던 정신간호학 만점자는 올해 1천263명이었다.
하지만 2022년 1천364명이었던 기본간호학 만점자는 오히려 올해 절반 수준인 682명으로 줄었고, 같은 기간 간호관리학 만점자도 298명에서 133명으로 줄었다.
복지부 관계자는 "어떤 과목은 점수가 올라갈 수 있고 다른 과목은 내려갈 수 있는데 특정 과목 만점자 수만 갖고 이상이 있다고 (부정행위가 있었다고) 보기는 어렵다"며 "특히 의사·간호사 국시는 기존에도 합격률이 높았고, 의사 국시는 필기시험 외에 실기시험도 있다"고 설명했다.
이어 "최근 5년간의 (보건의료인 국시) 합격점수를 점검했는데 정규분포에서 벗어나는 사례는 없어서 전체적으로 이상 사례가 없다고 판단했다"고 설명했다.

items.title: 마운자로에 가짜 비아그라까지…불법의약품 판매 일당 적발(종합)
items.summary:
불법 의약품 밀반입·판매 일당 25명 적발
6년간 28만개 밀반입, 판매액 27억원 규모
가짜 발기부전약·마운자로까지 유통
전체 내용을 이해하기 위해서는 기사 본문과 함께 읽어야 합니다.
(서울=연합뉴스) 박상현 기자 = 비만약 '마운자로'와 '동전파스'를 비롯한 각종 해외 유통 의약품과 가짜 의약품, 건강기능식품, 수입 금지 식품 등을 국내에 몰래 반입해 판매한 일당이 당국에 적발됐다.
식품의약품안전처는 26일 의약품을 밀반입한 수입자 1명, 이들 제품을 거래한 중간 판매자 2명과 전통시장 소매상 22명 등 25명을 관련 법률 위반 혐의로 적발해 서울서부지방공소청에 송치했다고 밝혔다.
식약처가 이날 브리핑을 통해 공개한 불법 판매 의약품은 '타이레놀', '애드빌', '아스피린', '용각산', '정로환', '로이히쓰보코 동전파스' 등 다양했다.
식약처에 따르면 수입자 A씨는 수입 판매업 허가·등록 절차를 거치지 않고 2020년 9월께부터 올해 8월까지 6년간 해외 직접구매(직구)나 기내 수하물을 이용한 반입 등의 방법으로 해외에서 의약품, 의약외품, 식품 등 28만개 제품을 밀반입했다.
A씨는 이들 제품 중 25만여 개를 중간 판매자와 지인 등에게 현금 거래 형식으로 판매했다. 판매액은 27억원에 달했다.
그는 글루카곤 유사 펩타이드-1(GLP-1) 계열 비만치료제 수요가 급증하자 올해 7월에는 일본에서 '마운자로' 48개를 두 차례에 걸쳐 몰래 반입해 판매한 것으로 조사됐다.
식약처 관계자는 "A씨가 브로커를 통해 고용량 마운자로를 다량 구매하는 방안을 협의했으나, 이번 적발로 실행하지 못했다"고 말했다.
식약처는 A씨가 보관 중이던 불법 의약품 2천182개를 모두 압수했다.
중간 판매자 B씨, C씨는 A씨와 신원을 알 수 없는 보따리상 등으로부터 무허가 의약품 등을 구입해 개인 창고에 보관하다가 전통시장 내 수입상가 소매상 등에게 공급했다고 식약처는 전했다.
B씨는 2020년 1월께부터 올해 8월까지 20만여 개(약 22억원 상당), C씨는 2022년 1월께부터 올해 8월까지 4만여 개(약 4억원 상당)의 무허가 의약품 등을 각각 판매한 것으로 파악됐다.
특히 C씨가 창고에 보관 중이던 비아그라 등 발기부전 치료제 9개는 유효 성분이 없거나 미확인 성분이 다량으로 검출된 가짜 의약품이었다고 식약처는 설명했다.
전통시장 소매상 22명은 한글 표시가 없는 무허가 의약품, 건강기능식품을 진열해 판매하다 적발됐다.
식약처는 중간 판매상과 소매상이 보관하던 물품도 모두 압수했다.
식약처는 전통시장 내 의약품 불법 판매를 수사하는 과정에서 유통 경로를 추적해 밀반입자, 중간 판매자, 소매상으로 이르는 유통 사슬을 통째로 적발한 것은 이번이 처음이라고 강조했다.
앞서 식약처는 올해 6∼8월 서울 남대문시장과 대구 교동시장을 대상으로 불법 의약품 판매를 점검한 바 있다.
김진휘 식약처 위해사범중앙조사단장은 "한글 표시 사항이 없는 수입 의약품, 건강기능식품은 정식으로 허가·신고가 이뤄지지 않은 제품으로 진위를 확인하기 어렵다"며 "정상적으로 유통·판매되는 제품을 구매해야 한다"고 당부했다.
이어 "의약품 피해 구제는 국내에서 허가된 제품을 정상적 경로로 구입해 복용하던 중 발생한 피해에 대해서만 받을 수 있다"며 "휴대 반입해 국내에 가져온 마운자로 등을 되팔거나 해외에서 구매한 의약품을 반복적으로 반입하는 행위는 명백한 불법"이라고 덧붙였다.

items.title: 李대통령 "희귀·중증환자 보험료 부담 낮춰…희망 키우겠다"
items.summary:
李대통령 "희귀·중증환자 본인부담율 7%로 인하"
약 37만명 혜택…1인당 연평균 22만원 경감
"대선 약속대로 치료비 부담 지속 축소"
전체 내용을 이해하기 위해서는 기사 본문과 함께 읽어야 합니다.
(서울=연합뉴스) 임형섭 기자 = 이재명 대통령은 26일 "다음 달부터 희귀·중증 질환자 건강보험의 본인부담율이 10%에서 7%로 낮아진다"며 "(이를 통해) 희귀·중증 질환자의 치료비 걱정을 덜고 치료받을 희망을 키울 것"이라고 말했다.
이 대통령은 이날 자신의 엑스(X·옛 트위터)를 통해 건강보험 부담률 변화를 소개하는 기사를 공유한 뒤 "약 37만명이 혜택을 받고 한 분당 연평균 22만원가량 부담이 줄어들 것"이라며 이같이 밝혔다.
이 대통령은 "지난해 크리스마스 이브에 희귀질환 환우와 가족들을 만나 치료와 진단 과정에서 겪는 어려움과 막막한 의료비 부담에 대해 얘기를 들었다"며 "그때 여러분이 들려주신 목소리를 바탕으로 치료비 부담을 덜어드릴 방안을 하나씩 마련해 왔다"고 설명했다.
그러면서 "그 변화가 이제 실제 혜택으로 이어지는 것"이라며 "대선 때 국민께 약속드린 대로 치료비 부담을 지속적으로 줄일 것"이라고 강조했다.

items.title: 울산 동구, 병원 찾기 어려운 주민에게 방문의료 지원
items.summary:
울산 동구, 거동 불편 주민 방문의료 지원
의사·간호사·사회복지사 협력 맞춤 지원
지역 의료기관 연계 돌봄 체계 구축 방침
전체 내용을 이해하기 위해서는 기사 본문과 함께 읽어야 합니다.
(울산=연합뉴스) 장지현 기자 = 울산 동구는 거동이 불편해 병원을 찾기 어려운 주민을 위해 의사, 간호사, 사회복지사가 협력하는 방문의료 지원 사업을 추진한다고 26일 밝혔다.
이번 사업은 통합돌봄 수요 조사에서 보건·의료 분야 지원을 원하는 주민이 많은 것으로 나타난 데 따른 것이다.
대상자 가정을 방문해 건강 상태와 생활 여건을 확인하고, 의료서비스 이용 어려움과 건강·돌봄 욕구를 살펴서 맞춤형 지원 방안을 검토한다.
동구는 지역 의료기관과 협력해 주민별로 필요한 의료·돌봄 서비스를 연계하고, 맞춤형 방문의료 지원 체계를 구축할 방침이다.
동구 관계자는 "누구나 살던 곳에서 건강하고 안정적 생활을 이어갈 수 있도록 촘촘한 의료·돌봄 지원체계를 마련하겠다"고 말했다.

items.title: 의령군, 내년 군정 화두는 '정착'…예산안 5천38억원 편성
items.summary:
오태완 의령군수 "내년 군정 화두는 정착"
버스 완전공영제·민생기동대 정착 추진
내년 예산 5천38억원…올해보다 349억 감소
전체 내용을 이해하기 위해서는 기사 본문과 함께 읽어야 합니다.
(의령=연합뉴스) 박영민 기자 = 오태완 경남 의령군수가 내년도 군정의 화두로 '정착'을 제시했다.
26일 의령군에 따르면 오 군수는 전날 열린 제302회 의령군의회 제2차 정례회 시정연설에서 "민선 8기가 의령의 변화를 시작했다면, 민선 9기는 그 변화를 완성해 나가는 시기"라며 "그동안 시작한 변화가 확실히 자리 잡는 '정착의 해'가 되어야 한다"고 밝혔다.
오 군수는 버스 완전공영제와 민생현장기동대 등 생활 밀착형 정책을 정착시키고, 청년과 가족이 지역에 머물 수 있도록 일자리·주거와 교육·돌봄 여건을 개선하겠다고 했다.
또 부림일반산업단지 기업 유치와 농업·관광 활성화를 통해 군민 소득을 높이고 일자리를 늘리겠다는 구상도 내놨다.
군은 내년도 예산안을 올해 본예산보다 349억원(6.49％) 줄어든 5천38억원 규모로 편성했다. 일반회계 4천335억원, 특별회계 703억원이다.
군은 호우 피해 복구사업과 대형 사업의 국·도비 보조금 감소 등 재정 여건을 고려해 핵심 사업에 재원을 우선 배분했다고 설명했다.
분야별로는 사회복지가 1천21억원으로 가장 많고, 농림 1천4억원, 국토·지역개발 560억원, 환경 529억원 등이다.
주요 사업으로는 일자리 연계 청년 임대아파트 100세대 건립에 82억원, 의령형 기본소득에 53억원, 부림면 농촌중심지활성화사업에 32억원을 편성했다.
의령 유스호스텔 조성에 40억원, 의령명품 100리길 조성에 37억원도 반영했다.
오 군수는 "정책은 일상이 되고, 사람은 머물며, 산업은 성장하는 의령을 만들겠다"고 강조했다.
 ymp@yna.co.kr

items.title: 건보 지역가입자 11월 보험료 평균 9만6천원…작년보다 4%↑
items.summary:
건보 지역가입자 11월 보험료 평균 9만5천860원
작년보다 4% 올라…10세대 중 3세대 상승
휴·폐업·소득·재산 변동 시 보험료 조정 신청
전체 내용을 이해하기 위해서는 기사 본문과 함께 읽어야 합니다.
(서울=연합뉴스) 김영신 기자 = 건강보험 지역가입자의 지난해 소득과 올해 재산을 반영한 11월분 보험료가 월평균 9만5천860원으로, 작년 같은 달보다 4.0% 올랐다.
전체 지역가입 세대 936만 세대 중 30.7%는 전월보다 보험료가 늘었고, 23.7%는 줄었다.
국민건강보험공단은 지역가입 세대의 11월분 보험료부터 2025년도 귀속 소득과 2026년도 재산 과세표준을 새로 반영해 보험료를 산정했다고 26일 밝혔다.
이번에 산정된 보험료는 11월부터 내년 10월까지 1년간 적용한다. 11월분 보험료는 12월 10일까지 납부해야 한다.
올해 11월 평균 보험료는 9만5천860원으로 전년 대비 4.0%(3천712원) 상승했다.
총 936만 지역가입 세대 중 전월 대비 보험료에 변동이 없는 세대는 427만 세대(45.6%)다.
감소한 세대는 221만 세대(23.7%), 증가한 세대는 288만 세대(30.7%)로 집계됐다.
보험료 부과 자료를 반영한 이후에도 휴·폐업 등으로 소득 활동이 중단되거나, 소득이 증가 또는 감소한 경우, 재산 매각이나 전·월세금 변경 등으로 재산에 변동이 생긴 경우에는 증빙서류를 내고 보험료 조정을 신청할 수 있다.
조정 신청은 공단 지사를 방문하거나 팩스·우편으로 가능하다.
휴·폐업 신고자는 공단 모바일 애플리케이션이나 홈페이지에서 서류 없이 신청할 수 있다.
건보공단은 "앞으로도 소득 중심 부과 체계 개편을 통해 보험료 부담의 공정성과 형평성을 높여 나가겠다"고 밝혔다.

items.title: 제주도, 12월부터 한랭질환 응급실 감시체계 가동
items.summary:
제주도, 12월부터 한랭질환 응급실 감시체계 가동
내년 2월 말까지 응급실 6곳 등서 환자 확인
지난 겨울 환자 8명, 65세 이상 5명·저체온증
전체 내용을 이해하기 위해서는 기사 본문과 함께 읽어야 합니다.
(제주=연합뉴스) 전지혜 기자 = 제주도는 한파로 인한 건강 피해를 줄이기 위해 12월 1일부터 내년 2월 28일까지 '한랭질환 응급실 감시체계'를 운영한다고 26일 밝혔다.
감시체계에는 도내 응급 의료기관 6곳과 제주시·서귀포시 보건소가 참여한다.
도는 환자 발생 현황을 관계 기관과 공유하고, 한파특보가 내려지면 예방 수칙을 집중적으로 알릴 계획이다.
앞서 지난 겨울(2025년 12월∼2026년 2월) 제주에서 한랭질환으로 응급실을 찾은 환자는 8명으로, 전년 같은 기간(2024년 12월∼2025년 2월) 1명보다 늘었다.
지난 겨울 제주에서 신고된 8건은 모두 저체온증이었고, 환자 8명 중 5명은 65세 이상이었다. 집 안에서 발생한 사례가 4건, 길가 등 실외에서 발생한 사례가 4건이었다.
도는 집 안에서도 한랭질환이 발생하는 만큼 실내를 따뜻하게 유지하고, 외출 전에는 체감온도와 한파특보를 확인해 달라고 당부했다.
조상범 도 안전건강실장은 "어르신과 만성질환자 등은 한파특보가 내려지면 외출을 자제하고 외출할 때는 목도리·모자 등으로 보온에 각별히 신경 써 달라"고 당부했다.

items.title: 학교 넘어 온 동네가 아이 돌본다…경북도, 초등돌봄 확대
items.summary:
경북도, 대학·지역사회 연계 초등돌봄 확대
21개 대학 참여, 특화 프로그램 25개 추가
27일부터 구미코서 초등돌봄 페스타 개최
전체 내용을 이해하기 위해서는 기사 본문과 함께 읽어야 합니다.
(안동=연합뉴스) 이승형 기자 = 경북도는 대학·지역사회와 손잡고 초등 돌봄 프로그램을 확대한다고 26일 밝혔다.
지역 성장 인재 양성체계(앵커, 옛 라이즈)를 바탕으로 학교 중심의 초등돌봄을 지역사회 전반으로 확장하고 대학, 교육청, 지역기관이 함께 아이들의 성장과 배움을 책임지는 돌봄·교육체계를 만든다.
맞춤형 돌봄·방과 후 교육프로그램 운영 사업에는 대구가톨릭대학교를 주관대학으로 21개 대학이 참여한다.
지난해에는 교육프로그램 100개를 개발해 도내 163개 초등학교 학생 2만2천952명에게 제공했다.
올해는 기존 프로그램에 경제, 주말가족, 특수학급 분야 특화 프로그램 25개를 추가했으며 내년에는 기존 프로그램을 고도화하고 특화 프로그램을 40개 개발할 예정이다.
도는 지역 대학과 교육청, 관계기관 간 협력을 강화해 아이들이 지역 어디에서나 양질의 돌봄과 교육을 누릴 수 있도록 한다는 방침이다.
저출생 극복과 지역 정주 여건 개선으로 이어지는 지속 가능한 돌봄·교육 생태계도 조성한다.
도는 27일부터 이틀간 구미코에서 '경북 온동네 초등돌봄·교육 페스타'를 열어 이런 돌봄 성과를 공유하고 발전 방향을 논의한다.
이상수 경북도 지방정부전략국장은 "아이 키우는 일은 더 이상 개별 가정만의 책임이 아니라 지역사회가 함께 책임져야 할 중요한 과제"라며 "대학과 초등학교, 지역사회가 힘을 모아 아이들에게는 더 큰 배움과 성장의 기회를, 부모에게는 믿고 맡길 수 있는 돌봄 환경을 제공하겠다"고 말했다.

items.title: 서울 중구 '언제나 튼튼센터' 내달 4일 구민 건강페스티벌
items.summary:
서울 중구, 내달 4일 '중구민 건강페스티벌'
구민 500여명 운동·체력측정·건강체험 제공
언제나 튼튼센터 월평균 570명 이용 성과
전체 내용을 이해하기 위해서는 기사 본문과 함께 읽어야 합니다.
(서울=연합뉴스) 정준영 기자 = 서울 중구(구청장 김길성)는 통합건강증진센터인 '언제나 튼튼센터'가 다음 달 4일 오후 4∼8시 중구구민회관에서 '중구민 건강페스티벌'을 개최한다고 26일 밝혔다.
이 행사는 중구민과 중구 생활권자 500여명을 대상으로 운동과 체력측정, 건강체험을 한자리에서 제공하는 참여형 축제다.
지난 3월 을지누리센터에 문을 연 '언제나 튼튼센터'는 운동·영양·건강관리 서비스를 통합 지원하는 시설이다. 월평균 570명이 이용 중이며, '러닝의 정석' 등 일일강좌부터 계절별 운동 특강까지 다양한 프로그램으로 호응을 얻고 있다.
이번 페스티벌은 센터의 운영 성과를 공유하는 동시에 어린이부터 어르신까지 직접 몸을 움직이며 건강 상태를 확인할 수 있도록 꾸몄다. 행사에서는 건강운동 프로그램과 상설 체험부스, 스마트 체력측정존 등이 운영된다.
일부 프로그램은 사전 신청제로 운영한다. 참여하려면 안내 포스터에 있는 QR코드를 통해 신청하면 된다.
김길성 구청장은 "이번 축제는 언제나 튼튼센터가 주민들과 함께 만들어온 건강한 변화를 돌아보고, 더 많은 주민이 운동의 즐거움을 경험하는 자리"라며 "가족과 함께 방문해 더욱 건강한 새해를 준비하시길 바란다"고 말했다.

items.title: 보험 판매수수료 과당경쟁 막는다…지급한도·공시 규제 강화
items.summary:
금융위, 보험 판매수수료 지급한도 규제 강화
사업비 공시 의무 전체 연령·납입기간 확대
내년 1월 행정지도 시행…보험료 부담 완화
전체 내용을 이해하기 위해서는 기사 본문과 함께 읽어야 합니다.
(서울=연합뉴스) 강수련 기자 = 금융당국이 보험 판매수수료의 과도한 경쟁을 억제하기 위해 지급한도 규제를 강화하고, 사업비 공시 의무도 확대한다. 소비자의 보험료 부담을 완화하기 위한 조치다.
금융위원회는 내년 1월 판매수수료 개편방안 시행에 맞춰 이런 내용의 행정지도를 시행한다고 26일 밝혔다.
당국이 마련한 개편안에 따라 내년 1월부터 수수료 분급제도가 시행되며, 선지급수수료와 유지관리수수료는 각각 수수료 지급 목적으로 보험료에 반영될 '계약체결비용' 이내에서 지급해야 한다.
다만 보험사가 계약체결비용 자체를 높게 설정해 판매수수료 지급 한도를 늘릴 수 있어 추가로 제한을 두기로 했다.
보험사는 계약체결비용과 표준해약공제액(종신사망보험은 1.4배) 가운데 적은 금액 이내에서 판매수수료를 집행해야 한다.
사업비 공시 의무도 확대된다.
현재는 만 40세, 최장기납 등 기준연령 요건에서 계약체결비용이 표준해약공제액을 초과할 때 공시의무를 부과하지만, 앞으로는 전체 연령·납입기간 조건으로 범위를 확대한다.
금융당국의 실태조사 결과, 공시 규제가 적용되지 않는 상품까지 포함한 전체 계약조건에서 회사별 평균 약 10%에서 계약체결비용이 표준해약공제액을 초과했다.
해당 계약조건의 계약체결 비용은 표준해약공제액보다 평균 57% 높았다.
당국은 기초서류에 판매수수료 지급기준을 명확히 반영하고, 수익성 분석과 실제 수수료 지급 시 해당 기준을 준수하도록 관리·감독도 강화할 방침이다.
사업비 집행 관련 규제는 내년 1월 1일, 사업비 공시는 2월 1일부터 체결되는 보험계약부터 적용된다.
당국은 우선 행정지도를 시행하고 보험업감독규정 개정도 병행 추진할 예정이다. 또 현황 점검을 통해 변칙적인 수수료 지급행위는 엄정 대응할 계획이다.
금융위는 "보험사는 보험료와 보장내용 등 상품 자체 경쟁력을 중심으로 경쟁할 것"이라며 "공시 강화 등으로 소비자의 보험료 부담을 완화하고 합리적인 상품 선택을 지원하겠다"고 말했다.
 training@yna.co.kr

items.title: 금감원, 부적격 유사투자자문업체 106개 직권 말소
items.summary:
금감원, 부적격 유사투자자문업체 106개 말소
폐업·법령 위반 등 사유…누적 1천767개
직권말소 업체 5년간 영업 불가
전체 내용을 이해하기 위해서는 기사 본문과 함께 읽어야 합니다.
(서울=연합뉴스) 강수련 기자 = 금융감독원은 1천863개 유사투자자문업자를 전수 점검해 106개 부적격 업체를 직권말소 처리했다고 26일 밝혔다.
사유별로는 폐업 99개, 금융관련법령 위반 9개, 과태료 2회 처분 1개다. 폐업과 법령 위반이 중복된 업체는 3개다.
2019년 7월 직권말소 제도 도입 이후 직권말소된 업체는 누적 1천767개다.
금융 관련 법령과 소비자보호 관련 법령 위반, 불건전 영업행위 등으로 인한 과태료 처분, 폐업 등 사유로 직권말소된 업체는 향후 5년간 유사투자자문업을 영위할 수 없다.
금감원은 "주기적으로 점검해 부적격 유사투자자문업자를 신속히 퇴출하고 유사투자자문업자 이용 시 투자자 유의사항을 안내하겠다"고 말했다.

items.title: 은행·저축은행 협업해 중저신용자 신용대출…금리 평균 10%로
items.summary:
금융위, 은행·저축은행 '포용 온렌딩 대출' 추진
중저신용자에 평균 10% 금리로 신용대출 공급
금융권 연체채권 관리 실적 반기별 공시키로
전체 내용을 이해하기 위해서는 기사 본문과 함께 읽어야 합니다.
(서울=연합뉴스) 강수련 기자 = 금융당국이 은행과 저축은행이 협업해 중저신용자에게 저리로 신용대출을 공급하는 '포용 온렌딩 대출'을 추진한다.
아울러 건전성 규제를 합리화해 금융권의 포용금융 공급 여력을 확대하고, 금융회사의 연체채권 관리 실적도 반기별로 공시하도록 한다.
금융위원회는 26일 8차 포용적 금융 대전환 회의를 열고 관계기관 및 민간 전문가와 함께 포용금융 확대를 위한 방안을 발표했다.
금융위에 따르면 시장금리 상승으로 대부분 업권에서 중·고신용자 금리는 상승했지만, 저신용자 금리는 은행 0.05%포인트(p), 저축은행 0.27%p 등 하락했다.
 다만 2금융권 중신용자에서 금리가 급격하게 높아지는 '금리 단층' 구조는 여전히 남아있다.
이를 완화하기 위해 은행이 저축은행에 자금을 공급하고, 저축은행이 이를 재원으로 중저신용자에게 대출을 실행하는 포용 온렌딩 대출을 도입한다.
대상은 새희망홀씨 상품 지원대상 범위 내의 중저신용자다. 금리는 은행과 저축은행이 자율적으로 결정하되 최종 대출금리는 평균 10% 내외로 운용할 계획이다.
금융위는 이를 통해 소비자가 기존 저축은행 대출보다 약 3∼5%p 낮은 금리로 대출을 받을 수 있을 것으로 보고 있다.
우리은행의 경우 계열사인 우리금융저축은행에 자금을 공급해, 중저신용자에 약 500∼1천억원 한도로 신용대출을 공급할 예정이다. 대출금리는 연 8∼12% 수준이 적용될 전망이다.
금융위는 기획형 규제 샌드박스를 통해 관련 규제 특례를 부여하고, 내년 초 혁신금융서비스를 지정해 1분기 내 온렌딩 대출 상품을 출시할 예정이다.
 은행의 온렌딩 대출 실적은 새희망홀씨 실적으로 인정하고, 신용보증기금·기술보증기금·지역신용보증재단 등에 대한 출연료 납부대상에서 제외하는 등 인센티브도 부여한다.
금융당국은 포용금융을 확대하기 위한 건전성 규제도 합리화한다.
우선 소상공인시장진흥공단 보증부대출 등에 적용되는 위험가중치(RW)를 기존 20%에서 0%로 낮춘다. 신용리스크 RW 0%가 적용되는 공공기관은 시장리스크 산출 시 부도리스크에도 기존 0.5∼15%가 아닌 0%를 적용한다.
보험업권에서는 서민금융진흥원을 지급여력비율(K-ICS) 체계상 적격 보증인으로 인정해 보증부대출에 적용하는 위험계수를 8%에서 2.5%로 낮춘다.
은행의 대안신용평가모형 활용 범위도 확대한다. 기존 여신심사에 더해 규제모형으로 승인해 자본비율 산출 및 충당금 산정 등에 활용할 수 있도록 한다. 이를 통해 같은 자본으로 더 많은 중저신용자 대출을 공급하도록 한다.
은행·보험·여전사·저축은행의 자체 채무조정한 대출 가운데 채무조정 시점 '요주의 여신'이었던 대출은 6개월 이상 정상 상환되는 경우, '정상 여신'으로 분류하도록 한다.
카드사 채권은 연체 이전에 자체 채무조정 또는 신용회복위원회 신속채무조정을 받은 경우 연체 채권에서 제외하고 정상 채권으로 분류할 수 있도록 한다.
저축은행의 개인사업자 대출은 현행 금융기관 차입금이 연간매출액 초과 요건에 더해 최근 2년 연속 순손실까지 충족해야 '요주의 여신'으로 분류한다.
은행의 자본 부담도 완화한다. 보완자본으로 인정되는 후순위채의 자본인정액을 매년 초 20%가 아닌 매 분기 초 5%씩 차감할 수 있도록 한다. 또 은행이 해외 집합투자증권 익스포져에 기초자산접근법을 사용해 낮은 RW를 적용할 수 있도록 허용한다.
 규제 개선 방안은 내년 1분기 중 업권별 감독규정과 시행세칙 개정과 해석을 거쳐 시행될 예정이다. 
금융당국은 은행·저축은행·상호금융(새마을금고 제외)·여전사·대부업체를 대상으로 올해 상반기 연체채권 관리 실적을 최초로 공시하도록 했다.
올해 상반기 금융권은 개인 연체채권 총 35만5천건, 1조6천억원을 소멸시효 완성 또는 중도 소각했다. 소멸시효 도래 전 소각 규모는 1조3천억원(28만4천건)으로 금액 기준 82%를 차지했다.
같은 기간 자체 채무조정은 총 34만1천건, 13조9천억원 규모로 이뤄졌다. 은행(15만6천건)과 여전사(13만7천건)가 대부분이었다.
개인연체채권 7조8천억원(대출원금 잔액), 92만7천건이 3조9천504억원에 매각됐다.
금융위는 반기별로 실적을 공시해 금융권의 기계적인 소멸시효 연장 관행을 개선하고 선제적인 자체 채무조정을 활성화할 예정이다.
내년부터는 은행권을 대상으로 포용금융 종합평가를 통해 개인연체채권 관리 실적을 평가할 계획이다.
이억원 금융위원장은 "최근 금리 상승에도 포용금융 공급은 역대 최고 수준"이라며 "저신용자 금리는 낮아지고 대출잔액은 증가했으며 연체 채무자의 경제적 재기 지원도 확대되고 있다"고 평가했다.
이어 "포용금융의 양적 확대를 넘어 지속가능한 포용금융 시스템을 구축하는 데 집중해야 한다"고 말했다.

items.title: 코스피, 장초반 2%대 상승…4,800선 탈환 시도(종합)
items.summary:
코스피, 전날 6%대 급락 딛고 2%대 반등
삼성전자·SK하이닉스·이차전지주 강세
한은 금통위 기준금리 결정·경제전망 주목
전체 내용을 이해하기 위해서는 기사 본문과 함께 읽어야 합니다.
(서울=연합뉴스) 곽윤아 기자 = 전날 6% 넘게 급락했던 코스피 지수가 26일 장 초반 2% 안팎의 상승률을 보이고 있다.
이날 오전 9시 24분 코스피 지수는 전장보다 97.19포인트(2.07%) 오른 4,794.70이다.
지수는 전장 대비 47.59포인트(1.01%) 오른 4,745.10으로 출발해 오름 폭을 조절하다, 다시 상승세가 강해져 4,800선을 웃돌기도 했다.
유가증권시장에서 외국인은 566억원 순매수 중이다. 개인과 기관은 50억원, 687억원 매도 우위다.
기업의 자사주 매입이 반영되는 기타법인은 146억원 순매수 중이다.
코스피200선물 시장에서 외국인은 1천160억원 매도 우위다.
간밤 뉴욕증시에서 다우존스30 산업평균지수는 0.33% 올랐다. 스탠더드앤드푸어스(S&P)500지수와 나스닥종합지수는 각각 0.25%, 0.62% 내렸다. 필라델피아 반도체지수는 0.65% 하락했다.
개장 전 발표된 미국의 10월 개인소비지출(PCE)는 전년 동월 대비 3.8% 올라, 전월(3.6%)보다 상승 폭을 키웠다. 미국의 주요 경제주체에 대한 신규 관세 부과 예고, 인공지능(AI) 투자 불안이 지속되자 뉴욕증시는 장중 큰 폭으로 내렸다.
다만 최근 급락에 따른 저가매수세가 유입되자 낙폭을 상당부분 만회해 나가는 '전약후강'의 흐름을 보였다.
국내 증시는 전날 급락(-6.16%) 이후 반발 매수세가 일부 유입되며 반등을 시도하는 것으로 보인다.
전날 9.9% 급락했던 삼성전자[005930]는 이날 2.28% 올라 일단 하락세를 끊어냈다.
SK하이닉스[000660]는 전날 11.05% 급락을 딛고 이날 3.88% 강세를 보이고 있다.
시가총액 상위 종목 중 SK스퀘어[402340](2.05%), LG에너지솔루션[373220](1.46%), 삼성전기[009150](5.43%) 등은 강세다. 삼성바이오로직스[207940](-0.95%), 현대차[005380](-1.67%), KB금융[105560](-2.09%), 신한지주[055550](-2.35%) 등은 약세다.
삼성SDI[006400](6.82%), 에코프로머티[450080](6.46%), 포스코퓨처엠[003670](5.86%) 등 이차전지주 전반이 큰 폭으로 상승 중이다.
업종별로 보면 IT서비스(1.76%), 전기·전자(1.71%), 의료·정밀(1.36%) 등은 오르고 있다. 부동산(-1.67%), 운송·창고(-1.31%), 섬유·의류(-0.92%) 등은 약세다.
같은 시각 코스닥 지수는 전장보다 21.20포인트(3.26%) 오른 671.84다.
지수는 전장보다 7.82포인트(1.20%) 오른 658.46으로 출발해 상승 폭이 커졌다.
코스닥 시장에서 외국인과 기관이 각각 372억원, 335억원 순매수 중이다. 개인은 696억원 순매도하고 있다.
에코프로비엠[247540](4.03%), 에코프로[086520](3.47%) 등 이차전지주가 강세다. 전날 큰폭으로 내렸던 주성엔지니어링[036930](11.91%), 심텍[222800](2.85%), 리노공업[058470](6.89%), 이오테크닉스[039030](5.67%) 등은 반등에 나서고 있다.
레인보우로보틱스[277810](1.94%), 로보티즈[108490](-1.73%) 등 시가총액 상위 로봇주는 등락이 엇갈리고 있다.
한편 오전 중 한국은행 금융통화위원회의 기준금리 결정과 수정 경제전망 발표, 이후 열릴 간담회에 이목이 집중된다.
업계에는 이날 한은 금통위가 기준금리를 3%에서 3.25%로 인상하고, 올해 성장률 전망치를 기존 3.3%에서 상향 조정할 것이라는 관측이 많다.
양현경 iM증권 연구원은 "한은이 성장률 전망을 높이고 내년 추가 인상을 강하게 시사한다면, 성장주의 밸류에이션 부담이 커질 수 있다"고 밝혔다.
